what_this_is: F-8's decontamination report: the rebuilt mixture against the certified 500-row held-out set, using the v2 admission gate's own instrument.

instrument.name: v2/gate_v2.py::overlap_scan (13-gram Jaccard + verbatim-span containment)
instrument.the_fast_pass: an inverted index over the holdout's 13-grams, which visits only the held-out documents that share a gram with the row; it is validated against the imported scan on the same 2,000-row sample for every source, and the validation is in this report

holdout.certified_by: the v1 benchmark's own 500-row split, exported by v2/export_holdout.py, which refuses to write a file that is not exactly 500 rows

bar.source: v2/gate-report.json — the maximum residual overlap the gate recorded across its admitted candidates
bar.rule: no source's residual overlap exceeds the gate's recorded maximum
